snippet.title: Alien Archeologist | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
What's the result of combining A Game About Digging a Hole, Powerwash Simulator & Aliens?! That's right! Alien Archeologist!

Dig! Dig! Dig! A digging game about unearthing secret alien artifacts, cleaning them and finding out what they hide within is coming soon!

Alien Archeologist is a chill digging game. Use a variety of upgradeable tools to mine ore, blast through earth, and clean strange artifacts as you journey yet deeper toward the mystery hiding at the planet's core.
